features: “Retired” Our Name is Mud Cuppa Doodle Mug
Features front, back and rim messaging: “Retired,” “To Do: Nap, Nap, Relax,” “All Play and No Work”

description: Just because someone retires, doesn’t mean they don’t have a packed schedule! Start the day off with a big cup of coffee in this colorful doodle mug before working on checking off the extensive daily to do list. Hmm… where to start? This 16 oz., high-quality porcelain mug is dishwasher and microwave safe.
